purpose: Recorded suite buckets for scripts/run-tests.ps1, scoped to the explicitly selected project. Resource batches run sequentially. Counts are not hardcoded; provide ExpectedCasesFile to verify the complete expected case multiset. Run the separate F# test project explicitly as well.

trait.name: Category
trait.applied_via: [Trait("Category", "<value>")] on a test method or class

values.ui: Needs the headless Avalonia session, Dispatcher/UI static state, or belongs to the Avalonia test collection.
values.fcs: Exercises the production F# compiler/checking pipeline.
values.compiled-extension: Exercises activation/execution of a compiled extension in the host process.
values.performance: Explicit performance or high-count endurance workload; excluded from normal correctness suites.

trait.combination_rule: A case may carry multiple values. Ownership priority is performance, then ui, then compiled-extension, then ordinary; filters exclude overlapping ownership categories.

batches.name: ordinary
batches.description: Tests without dedicated UI, compiled-extension, FCS, or performance resources.

batches.name: compiled-extension
batches.description: Compiled extension host integration and FCS/compiler checks; no legacy FSI or worker processes.

batches.name: performance
batches.description: Explicit high-count endurance/performance workloads. Not included in Full correctness coverage.

All.description: One dotnet test invocation, no filter.

Full.description: Normal correctness coverage for the selected project. Does not include high-count endurance/performance workloads. Use ExpectedCasesFile for complete case-multiset verification; also run the separate F# test project.

Fast.description: Explicit local feedback pass excluding only explicit performance workloads; not a replacement for Full.

Performance.description: Explicit manual performance/endurance entry point, separate from correctness acceptance.

Diagnostic.description: Same correctness coverage as Full, plus opt-in blame-hang mini dumps per batch.

r14_collection_audit.purpose: Collection boundaries and runner parallelism audit. UI collections retain their established process-global serialization.
r14_collection_audit.conclusion: DisableParallelization remains on both UI collections; no concurrency or algorithm changes are implied by suite bucketing.

all_suites: The target project must be built (or -NoBuild with a verified existing binary) before any batch runs; every batch shares the same build output.
Test outputs (TRX, summaries, dumps) stay under the repository .tmp directory.
Batches for one suite run sequentially in the declared order; the script must not start two batches of the same suite concurrently on the same machine.
A batch whose filter matches zero discovered cases fails the run (missing TRX or empty results).

skip_allowlist.description: Cases allowed to appear with outcome NotExecuted without failing the run's unexpected-skip check (matched by fully-qualified name). Conditional-skip cases not listed here make the run fail.
